applies_why: The text evaluates whether verses from the sign's chapter bounds count in the D5/C5 link and expressly says the matter is answered in named rounds.
quote: the sign's chapter bounds (Isaiah 7:16; 8:3-4; 8:8) are real, but C5's own narrowing concedes Matthew 1:23's application stands, and the almah/bethulah word-count cuts both ways (Joel 1:8); answered in [CR2] section G and [CR3] LINK 5.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: The judge marks the point underdetermined and says it was answered in named rounds, so it does not count any such verse as an unanswered witness toward a broken link.
